title: Mass isolation of staged Drosophila pupal intestines for analysis of protein ubiquitylation
protocol: Use a wet paint brush to gently move all pupae on the side of bottles to a 50 mL beaker with 1× PBS.
Wait for 2-3 minutes after moistening all pupae with water to detach them from bottle walls without damage.
Gently stir floating pupae with a brush to help dissociation.
Use a plastic spoon to remove and discard all floating pupae.
Transfer the PBS with the remaining pupae into an inverted embryo collection cage in a beaker.
Remove the collection cage and discard the PBS solution.
Gently shake the cage in a beaker with Milli-Q water 2–3 times to wash the pupae.
Remove the collection cage and discard the water.
Add 11% sucrose solution to the collection cage in a beaker, stir the solution.
Wait 2–3 min for separation of pupae based on buoyancy.
Use a pipette with the tip cut to be larger than the pupae to collect all pupae from the bottom of the sucrose solution.
Move the collected pupae to a 10 cm Petri dish with holes.
Place the Petri dish in a container lined with napkins or tissue paper to soak up excess sucrose solution.
Use a brush to move all pupae to a 5 cm Petri dish.
Place the 5 cm Petri dish on ice.
Dissect fly intestines using two forceps and a pair of scissors.
Place dissected intestines in a tube with chilled 1× PBS.
Remove PBS solution from the tube.
Add 40 μL Co-IP buffer supplemented with Halt Protease and Phosphatase Inhibitor (1:100).
Homogenize the intestines using a Micro-Grinder and a pestle.
Place the sample on ice.
Combine homogenates from all batches to create a single sample.
Add Co-IP buffer to 500 μL total volume.
Lysate for 1 hour at 4°C with rotation.
Remove 15 μL of lysate from each genotype.
Mix removed lysate with 15 μL 2× SDS sample buffer.
Centrifuge the remainder of the samples at 20,412 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Move supernatant to a new tube.
Measure protein concentration of each sample using bicinchoninic acid (BCA) protein assay kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
Wash 15 μL V5 trap agarose bead slurry with 1× PBS and centrifuge for 2 min at 1500 g to pellet beads.
Remove the supernatant and repeat the wash 2 more times.
Mix equal amounts of protein (800–1000 μg) from each sample with Co-IP buffer to a final volume of 1 mL.
Incubate the samples with V5 Trap agarose beads for 12–14 h with rotation at 4°C.
Spin the beads at 1500 g for 2 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and add 1 mL chilled Co-IP buffer.
Wash for 20 min with rotation at 4°C.
Repeat washing steps 5 times.
Remove the supernatant and add 50 μL 1× NuPAGE LDS Sample Buffer supplemented with β-mercaptoethanol (10%).
Boil the beads and input samples for 10 min at 100°C.
Spin down the beads at 1500 g for 5 min at 22°C.
Move the supernatant from the beads to a new tube.
Prepare a Novex Mini Protein Gel (12-well) for protein separation by electrophoresis.
Add 1× SDS running buffer into the assembled gel tank.
Load 20 μg of each input sample and IP lysates into the wells of a gel.
Run at 80 V until all lysates are stacked in the gel.
Change the voltage to 140 V when all lysates are stacked.
Continue running samples until the phenol red line reaches the bottom of the gel.
Transfer proteins to PVDF membrane in prechilled 1× transfer buffer for 90 min at 290 mA.
Block the membrane with 5% non-fat milk in 0.1% PBST for 1 h at 22°C.
Wash the membrane briefly and incubate with antibody against ubiquitin (1:1000) in EveryBlot blocking buffer for 12–14 h at 4°C with shaking.
Remove primary antibody from the membrane and wash it with 0.1% PBST for 15 min with shaking at 22°C.
Repeat washing step twice more.
Incubate the membrane with mouse HRP secondary antibody in 5% non-fat milk in 0.1% PBST for 1 h at 22°C with shaking.
Wash the membrane with 0.1% PBST for 15 min at 22°C.
Repeat washing step twice more.
Develop the membrane with SuperSignal West Pico PLUS Chemiluminescent Substrate or SuperSignal West Atto Ultimate Sensitivity Substrate.
Image the developed membrane using a ChemiDoc MP imaging system.
Briefly wash the membrane with 0.1% PBST and strip it with Restore PLUS Western Blot Stripping Buffer for 20 min at 22°C with shaking.
Wash the membrane with 0.1% PBST for 15 min at 22°C with shaking.
Repeat washing step twice more.
Block the membrane again with 5% non-fat milk in 0.1% PBST for 1 h at 22°C.
Incubate the membrane with antibody against V5 in EveryBlot blocking buffer (1:1,000) for 12–14 hours at 4°C with shaking.
Repeat steps 31–36.
Repeat steps 37–41 with antibody against Actin (1:1000).
